episodeTitle.en: Velocity over everything: How Ramp became the fastest-growing SaaS startup ever | Geoff Charles
episodeTitle.zh: 速度至上：Ramp如何成为增长最快的SaaS初创公司 | 杰夫·查尔斯

guestBioOfficial.en: Geoff Charles is VP of Product at Ramp—the fastest-growing SaaS startup of all time, Fast Company’s #1 Most Innovative Company in North America, and a company I believe we should all study for how they operate, execute, and hire. At Ramp, Geoff has led the product team from the early days, including the development and release of 60+ products and features in the past year alone. He has been building financial services for over a decade, and his interview in Lenny’s Newsletter quickly became one of the most widely read newsletter issues of all time. In today’s podcast, we will discuss: • How velocity is at the heart of Ramp’s culture and success
guestBioOfficial.zh: 杰夫·查尔斯是Ramp的副总裁——Ramp是史上增长最快的SaaS初创公司，曾获《快公司》北美最具创新力企业第一名。我认为我们都应该研究他们的运营、执行和招聘方式。在Ramp，杰夫从早期就领导产品团队，仅过去一年就开发并发布了60多款产品和功能。他从事金融服务领域十余年，其在Lenny’s Newsletter上的采访迅速成为有史以来阅读量最高的通讯内容之一。本期播客我们将探讨：• 速度如何成为Ramp文化和成功的核心

title.en: Velocity over everything: How Ramp became the fastest-growing SaaS startup ever | Geoff Charles
title.zh: 速度至上：Ramp如何成为增长最快的SaaS初创公司 | 杰夫·查尔斯

summary.en: Geoff offers a unique glimpse into Ramp's velocity-obsessed operating model: tiny teams (sometimes three engineers) that ship competitors to public companies in months and move billions of dollars a year. He explains how they operationalize a culture of speed through first-principles thinking and strong individual empowerment, how they organize planning and define strategy, and how they interview PMs while keeping an extremely high talent bar. He also addresses the real risk of burnout in such a fast culture and how to avoid it.
summary.zh: Geoff 带我们一窥 Ramp 以速度为核心的运营模式：极小的团队（有时仅三名工程师）能在几个月内做出上市竞品的对手产品，并每年流转数十亿美元。他解释了他们如何通过第一性原理思考和充分授权，把速度文化落到日常；如何组织规划、定义战略；以及如何在保持极高人才标准的同时面试 PM。他也谈到了这种高速文化下真实的倦怠风险，以及如何避免它。
